about: Which news sources VM links to put their articles behind a sign-up wall or a paywall. One entry a source: its class ("free": anyone can read the article; "signup": a free account is needed; "metered": a few free articles, then payment; "paid": payment needed; "unknown": it could not be checked, and it counts as free), what was seen and where, and the day it was checked. Classified from what an ordinary visitor sees: the site's own pages and the marks in them (schema.org isAccessibleForFree, content tiers, paywall software, "subscribers only" marks), and reliable descriptions (Wikipedia, Crossref's licence records for journals); nothing was signed into or got round. A site where most stories are free and a few are marked for subscribers (freemium) is "free", with the share of marked stories on its home page in its evidence, and an address rule (match) where the marked part has its own address; it is "paid" or "metered" when two in five or more of its home page's stories are marked, its ordinary articles lock, or a reliable description says it charges for most of them. A journal is "free" when more than half of its newest 40 articles carry an open licence in Crossref. A class set by hand from a description, because the site's own pages could not be seen, carries "manual": true. keys are the briefings' feed ids (political, science, econ, digital), hosts the home pages' hostnames (the Global Headline Tracker keys its outlets by them). match lists the parts of a site, told apart by the article's address, whose class differs. A publisher's own mark on one article (an open licence or isAccessibleForFree in its feed, LWN's "[$]") overrides its source's class. The rule that uses it is design/prp-access.js; tests/prp-access.test.mjs checks that every source VM collects from is here.

classes.signup: A free account is needed to read the article.
classes.metered: A few articles are free; after that, payment is needed.
classes.paid: Payment is needed to read the article.
classes.unknown: The source could not be checked; it counts as free.
